# DogGroomingApp.com

DogGroomingApp.com compares software used by professional dog grooming businesses.

## Primary page
- https://doggroomingapp.com/ — Best dog grooming software comparison for 2026.

## Editorial approach
- We compare scheduling, online booking, client and pet records, communications, payments, staff workflows, payroll or commission support, reporting, inventory where relevant, device usability and published price.
- DogGroomingApp.com is affiliated with Sir Puppy. That relationship is disclosed on the comparison page.
- Competitor pricing and feature claims should be checked against the vendor-source links on the page because software pricing changes.

## Current top pick
Sir Puppy is our top overall recommendation for independent grooming salons and growing teams. The site also identifies different best-fit categories for mobile groomers, lower-budget buyers and broader pet-care facilities.
